description: Rules for the bounded Plan, Execute, Verify, Critique, Repair loop. Control plane: agents cannot change it. harness/loop/loop.cjs reads it; validate-loop and the tests check the two agree. Limits are working values chosen by this design (the owner set the two headline limits: 3 repair attempts, 2 identical failures); they are not measured.

stateNotes.PLAN: The task contract is validated; nothing has run
stateNotes.EXECUTE: The first attempt is open: the assigned actor does the work
stateNotes.VERIFY: An attempt has ended; the loop itself runs the declared checks. Nobody else can mark work as successful
stateNotes.CRITIQUE: All checks pass and an independent reviewer is required
stateNotes.DIAGNOSE: A repair already failed; a diagnosis with a different approach is required before the next repair
stateNotes.REPAIR: Ready for, or in, a repair attempt
stateNotes.PASSED: Terminal. Reached only from VERIFY or CRITIQUE, by the loop, after every declared check passed on the current files (and an independent approval, when required)
stateNotes.ESCALATED: Terminal. A person must decide: budget used up, repeated failure, a policy check without a declared constraint, a blocked review or a non-idempotent step that failed
stateNotes.STOPPED: Terminal. Stopped immediately: permission violation, hard constraint, sensitive data, missing critical context, unsafe action or tampering

limitsNote: A task may tighten these but never raise them. 'Identical failures' counts the first occurrence, so the second identical failure escalates.

BUILD_ERROR.meaning: A build or type check failed

CONTRACT_FAILURE.meaning: A contract test failed: the code no longer matches the contract

CALCULATION_MISMATCH.meaning: A calculation did not match its separately documented expected result. The expected result is protected and never edited to make a test pass

TIMEOUT.meaning: A check exceeded its time limit

REVIEW_REWORK.meaning: The independent reviewer asked for rework

POLICY_VIOLATION.meaning: A policy check failed that has no declared hard constraint. Whether it is repairable is a human decision

NON_IDEMPOTENT_FAILURE.meaning: The attempt performed a destructive or non-idempotent operation and then failed. It is never retried automatically

REPEATED_FAILURE.meaning: The same failure happened the maximum number of times

BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.meaning: Repair attempts, check runs or wall-clock budget are used up

REVIEW_BLOCK.meaning: The independent reviewer blocked the work

HARD_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION.meaning: A check that guards a declared hard constraint failed. Fixing it needs an architecture decision, not a code repair

PERMISSION_VIOLATION.meaning: A tool action was denied by the guards or the permission engine, or touched a control-plane path

ACCESS_VIOLATION.meaning: A check that guards isolation failed (for example another shipowner's data was reached)

SENSITIVE_DATA.meaning: Changed files contain a credential shape or customer data marker

MISSING_CONTEXT.meaning: A check cannot run: a command, toolchain or context file is missing or changed

UNSAFE_ACTION.meaning: A reported action is one that may never happen inside a loop

TEST_TAMPERING.meaning: A protected file (a test, a fixture or an expected result) was changed

UNTRACKED_CHANGE.meaning: Files changed outside an attempt, so they were never screened

commandNote: A check is an argv that must match one pattern here, with no '..' and no absolute path. It runs without a shell, after the repository command guard. A task cannot add commands: this list is the only source. Operands of node --test cannot start with a dash, so no preload, loader, import or inspector option can be passed. 'tsc' resolves to the pinned toolchain below.

tsc.note: Installed outside the repository's manifest with: npm install typescript@5.9.3 --save-exact --ignore-scripts. The lock integrity is as recorded by the package feed used on the reviewing machine (a SHA-1 value, weak); it could not be cross-checked against the public registry from there. The entry file's SHA-256 is pinned as well.

opsNote: An action classified into noAutoRetryOps is not idempotent: if the attempt then fails, the loop escalates instead of retrying. An action classified into forbiddenOps stops the loop even if some guard allowed it, because those operations are never part of an automatic loop.
bypassNote: A diagnosis that proposes changing the test, the expected result or a guard is refused. This is a heuristic on wording; the protected-path check on the files themselves is the real control.
